items.title: 392 Lake Raponda Road, Wilmington
items.description: A rare opportunity for true year-round enjoyment. This is a remarkable chance to own a home on a motorboat lake - with a private dock - just minutes from both the Mount Snow and Hermitage Club ski resorts, hiking, biking, and snowmobile trails, and the charming village of Wilmington, Vermont. Lake Raponda stands apart from the other lakes in the area in one important way: because larger boats tend to head for the public-access Harriman Reservoir on the southern end of Wilmington, Raponda remains a predominantly owner-enjoyed lake. The result is noticeably less boat noise and wake, making it equally wonderful for kayaking, paddleboarding, and peaceful summer mornings on the water. The property sits on a generous, nicely sized parcel with sweeping level lawn space, a private yard with fire pit, ample parking, kayak racks, and a private dock - which transforms into an ice skating destination come winter. Inside the fully remodeled and expanded vintage four-bedroom, four-bath lake house, an open-concept floor plan invites you in with warm wood floors throughout, a living room anchored by a wood-burning stove set in a stone hearth, and a well-appointed kitchen with stainless appliances and island. A relaxing entertainment area with full bath flows into the heated sunroom addition, with expansive windows framing the lake views and opening onto a wraparound deck. A generous mudroom entry handles gear for every season with ease. Upstairs, the primary suite offers wonderful natural light and a luxurious bath, alongside three spacious guest bedrooms, two additional full baths, custom built-in storage, and a lovely office space. The practical upgrades here are just as impressive: efficient mini-split heating and air conditioning, an attached garage for gear storage, an updated septic system, and a private driveway with ample parking. All of it recently completed, the home is completely turnkey - so all you'll have to worry about is downtime, not upkeep.

facts.Heating: Heating Propane, Baseboard, Hot Water, Mini Split

items.title: 121 Fannie Hill Road
items.description: Owner will consider offers. Stunning contemporary chalet completely renovated in 2016 and located adjacent to the base of the Hermitage Club private ski resort. This gorgeous home sits on a private lot with direct snowmobile trail access, easy access to the ski trails, and direct to the clubhouse. Just a short drive into the village of Wilmington and the area's tremendous lakes. Thanks to the complete overhaul and meticulous maintenance, this home is turn key for immediate enjoyment, with features including an open concept design, large great room with vaulting ceilings and exposed beams, a stone hearth with wood burning fireplace, upscale country kitchen with stainless appliances and granite counters, a secondary wet bar area, sizeable dining table for all your guests, wood floors throughout, a main floor primary suite with walk-in closets and large tiled bath, dual rustic bunk rooms, a lower level guest suite, 7 spacious bedrooms in total, a large family room for great separate entertaining space, movies, and games, as well as an adjacent tv area, and a tremendous mudroom with built in cubbies for all your gear after a day on the trails. There is also a large covered front porch to keep the snow at bay with wood storage, massive hot tub, fenced in dog area, generator, tremendous parking, and nice lawn space without being much to maintain. With proximity like this and creature comforts from home, this makes for a great ski home, as well as a welcome respite from the metropolitan bustle year round.

items.title: 650 Francis Road, Barnard
items.description: Set on 400+/- acres in Barnard, Vermont, Monsalvat Farm is a legacy estate where rolling pastures, stone walls, forests, and mountain views reflect the state’s timeless character. Settled in 1793, the land carries generations of stewardship, elevated by one of the finest residences in the country—an architectural masterpiece complemented by historic and companion structures that are carefully integrated into the landscape with grace and permanence. Buildings include: the primary residence called "the Sanctuary" with 12-sided cathedral great room, primary bedroom suite with 2 bathrooms, one with fireplace, 7 additional fireplaces including one in the guest suite, wine cellar, music media room known as "the Cabin" and a dining room with stunning overhead sculpture positioned as an upside down tree with nested lights; a 2 bedroom 2 1/2 bathroom charming stone guest house, known as "Gilbert's Cottage;" a restored farmhouse with 4 separate apartments each with 1 bedroom and a full bathroom; a 1 bedroom 1 bathroom cabin called "the Lodge"; a restored historic barn with attached 5 stall stable, heated tack room and farm managers office with bathroom and shower; a Gazebo with fireplace, half bathroom and shower, a detached 3-bay garage, an equipment barn, a cattle barn and a sugar house. With a private gated entrance and bridge, built to highway specifications, over a large pond, a private FAA approved heliport, orchard, fields and miles of trails, Monsalvat Farm is truly magical.

items.title: 21 Sundance Village Loop, Dover
items.description: A rare opportunity to own a turnkey luxury mountain residence in one of Mount Snow’s most coveted ski-in/ski-out locations, perfectly positioned slope-side to the Sundance Lift and just minutes away from Haystack Mountain. This exceptional five-bedroom, five-bath contemporary home blends refined modern design with the timeless character of the Swiss Alps, creating a sophisticated yet inviting Vermont retreat. Designed for effortless four season living, the home features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area ideal for quiet mornings before first tracks, relaxed family time, and après ski entertaining. A beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen anchors the space, while expansive windows, natural materials, and curated finishes showcase the surrounding mountain landscape. Private amenities elevate the mountain experience, including a hot tub, sauna, dedicated theater room, and private ski tune room. A fully outfitted garage and generous storage provide ample space for skis, bikes, and all the essentials of four-season living. Enjoy the newly renovated and expanded Seasons Sports Center which offers amenities such as indoor and outdoor pools, basketball and tennis courts, fitness center, game room and owners’ lounge. This is more than a ski house, this is a timeless mountain retreat designed for every season where first tracks, fireside evenings, long dinners, and unforgettable gatherings become part of everyday life. With exceptional design, private amenities, and true ski in ski out access, this is elevated mountain living at its finest.

items.title: 56 Coldbrook Crossing, Wilmington
items.description: Spectacular custom home at the base of the Hermitage Club in the Coldbrook Crossing community, adjacent to the base of Haystack mountain. This is a stunning lot overlooking the trails and sunsets beyond, with easy mountain access, snowmobile trail access, and views unimpeded by any other homes. The luxurious features include a vaulted great room with exposed natural wood beams and stone hearth for the wood burning fireplace fireplace, expansive windows to the view affording great natural light, a chefs kitchen with large island, granite counters, stainless appliances, and walk-in pantry, custom bar area next to the open dining space, which leads out to the large wraparound entertaining deck, and a main floor primary bedroom suite. The upstairs features two guest bedrooms en suite, both with tiled showers, and a large office loft overlooking the view. The full finished walkout lower level has a large family room with stone hearth and gas fireplace, radiant heat, guest bedroom with another full tiled bath, bonus exercise room, and walk out access to the hot tub looking up at the slopes. There is also a formal entry off the covered front porch, which leads to the 2 car garage and mudroom with laundry and cubbies for your gear, perfect after a day on the slopes. Thanks to luxury finishes, recent construction, and professionally appointed furnishings, this home is turn key for your immediate enjoyment.

Designed for effortless four season living, the home features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area ideal for quiet mornings before first tracks, relaxed family time, and après ski entertaining. A beautifully appointed chef’s kitchen anchors the space, while expansive windows, natural materials, and curated finishes showcase the surrounding mountain landscape. Private amenities elevate the mountain experience, including a hot tub, sauna, dedicated theater room, and private ski tune room. A fully outfitted garage and generous storage provide ample space for skis, bikes, and all the essentials of four-season living. Enjoy the newly renovated and expanded Seasons Sports Center which offers amenities such as indoor and outdoor pools, basketball and tennis courts, fitness center, game room and owners’ lounge. This is more than a ski house, this is a timeless mountain retreat designed for every season where first tracks, fireside evenings, long dinners, and unforgettable gatherings become part of everyday life. With exceptional design, private amenities, and true ski in ski out access, this is elevated mountain living at its finest.

items.title: 56 Coldbrook Crossing, Wilmington
items.description: Spectacular custom home at the base of the Hermitage Club in the Coldbrook Crossing community, adjacent to the base of Haystack mountain. This is a stunning lot overlooking the trails and sunsets beyond, with easy mountain access, snowmobile trail access, and views unimpeded by any other homes. The luxurious features include a vaulted great room with exposed natural wood beams and stone hearth for the wood burning fireplace fireplace, expansive windows to the view affording great natural light, a chefs kitchen with large island, granite counters, stainless appliances, and walk-in pantry, custom bar area next to the open dining space, which leads out to the large wraparound entertaining deck, and a main floor primary bedroom suite. The upstairs features two guest bedrooms en suite, both with tiled showers, and a large office loft overlooking the view. The full finished walkout lower level has a large family room with stone hearth and gas fireplace, radiant heat, guest bedroom with another full tiled bath, bonus exercise room, and walk out access to the hot tub looking up at the slopes. There is also a formal entry off the covered front porch, which leads to the 2 car garage and mudroom with laundry and cubbies for your gear, perfect after a day on the slopes. Thanks to luxury finishes, recent construction, and professionally appointed furnishings, this home is turn key for your immediate enjoyment.

80 Maple Street, Acton
items.description: Looking for the ultimate in privacy? This is it! Located just a 5 minute drive from the Maine-NH border, in the heart of the York County Lakes Region, this home has it all! The hallway, leads to the LR w/ a pellet stove & entry to an open deck, overlooking the yard & raised garden beds. The primary bedroom en suite features a 4-piece bath - with double vanities, a shower stall and fantastic comfy soaking tub! 2 BR w/ closets, also with hardwood floors and bright sunshine streaming through the windows, as well as a full bath. The eat-in kitchen, just off the living room, features a quartz-topped island, granite counters, beautiful cabinets, gourmet gas stove, refrigerator and dishwasher and private dining area in the corner, by the window. Sited on 5+ wooded acres, at the end of a dead-end road, prepare to soak in nature that surrounds you. With several flowering trees - including cherry, apple, quince and more, the current owners have had great success with raised garden beds for vegetables, strawberries and more - there is even an asparagus bed!!! Downstairs holds an incredible opportunity for expansion - perhaps for an in-law apartment or even a rental. There is a finished kitchen and living room with wood stove, a full bath/laundry room, as well as a large unfinished area, with two more bedrooms - roughed-in, workshop space, a potting area and even a warming space for starting seedlings. Out in the back yard is space for more raised garden beds, a tarp-covered enclosure for car or tractor storage and a shed for tools. If you are a boating - fishing enthusiast, the property is only about a ten-minute drive to public boat launches for both Balch Lake & Great East Lake. Winter skiing is only about an hour's drive to the North Conway area, and ocean beaches within an hour. Only 2 hours from Boston & 1 hour from Portsmouth, NH & Portland, ME, this country home is just waiting for you to sample the QUIET PRIVACY of 5 wooded acres in Maine! Annual Rd. Maintenance $800
